T0552.title: DPIA
T0552.definition: A data protection impact assessment used to evaluate high-risk personal-data processing and mitigation measures.
T0552.description: A DPIA evaluates high-risk personal-data processing, including purpose, lawfulness, necessity, severity of risk, and mitigation. Compared with a general PIA, it emphasizes regulatory expectations and residual-risk explanation, often for large-scale sensitive processing, automated decisions, cross-border transfer, or high-risk monitoring.
T0552.usageExample: Assess DPIA related exposure and define the corresponding controls.

references.title: Art. 35 GDPR - Data protection impact assessment
